checks.title: Correctness
items: Off-by-one in boundary handling (empty input, single element, end of range).
Error paths that continue with a partially built value.
Resource leaks on the error path (opened but not closed).

checks.title: Change safety
items: Callers outside the diff depend on the changed signature, behavior or exit code.
Concurrency assumptions (ordering, visibility, single writer) that the change breaks.
Input validation removed or relaxed without a compensating check.

examples.code:
size_t n = buf->len;
if (n == 0u) return ERR_EMPTY;
